checks.name: corrected_metric_entries
checks.detail: every real z: the vielbein f0 = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2) Cot[z], f_i = E^a4, f4 = 1, f_t = E^(-a4) b4^(1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12) reproduces g; f0 ... f7 = E^(-a4) b4^2 Cot[z] (Sin[z]^2)^(1/4), so sqrt|det g| = E^(-a4) b4^2 |Cot[z]| (Sin[z]^2)^(1/4); g_tt = -E^(-2 a4) b4 w^2 < 0 with w = (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12) > 0; g44 = -1

checks.name: corrected_mixed_riemann_vanish
checks.detail: corrected metric, every real z: every nonzero R^{ab}_{cd} has {a, b} = {c, d} (112 nonzero entries with ordered pairs)

checks.name: corrected_offdiagonal_all_orders
checks.detail: corrected metric: the 56 off-diagonal components of E_(1), E_(2), E_(3) are identically 0 for all a4[x4], b4[x4] > 0 and every real z, and all diagonal components are independent of x0

checks.name: hidden_block_constant_curvature
checks.detail: the block Cot[z]^2 dx0^2 - (Sin[z]^2)^(1/6) (dx5^2 + dx6^2 + dx7^2): R^{ab}_{ab} = -H^2 for the six pairs a < b and no other independent component: constant curvature -H^2 for every real z (in the corrected metric the block carries the factor E^(-2 a4) b4)

checks.name: family_g44_fixed_conditions
checks.detail: family g00 = b4^(2p) E^(2 q a4) Cot[z]^2, g_ii = E^(2 a4) (Sin[z]^2)^(3 al), g44 = -1, g_tt = -E^(-2 a4) b4 (Sin[z]^2)^(3 be): R^{x0 xi}_{x4 xi} = 18 H Tan[z] E^(-2 q a4) b4^(-2 p) al ((q - 1) a4' + p b4'/b4) and R^{x0 xt}_{x4 xt} = 18 H Tan[z] E^(-2 q a4) b4^(-2 p) be ((q + 1) a4' + (p - 1/2) b4'/b4) for every real z: both vanish for all a4, b4 iff [al = 0 or (q, p) = (1, 0)] and [be = 0 or (q, p) = (-1, 1/2)]

checks.name: family_einstein_condition
checks.detail: with both of the author's warps (al = be = 1/6) E_(1)^x4_x0 is (nonzero factor) (2 q a4' + (2 p - 1/2) b4'/b4): zero for all a4, b4 iff q = 0, p = 1/4 (g00 = b4^(1/2) Cot[z]^2)

checks.name: record_metric_offdiagonal_reproduced
checks.detail: metric of 2026-10-14 (every real z): E_(1) has exactly 2 nonzero off-diagonal components ((x4, x0), (x0, x4)); E_(k)^x4_x0 != 0 for k = 1, 2, 3; sum_k alpha_k E_(k)^x4_x0 = the record's generalSource.offDiagonal_x4x0 (cot z u Q)

checks.name: version_1_g44_oscillates
checks.detail: version 1 (withdrawn): g44 = -(Sin[z]^2)^(1/6) has period Pi in z, is -1 at z = Pi/2 and 0 at z = 0: the lapse of the time x4 oscillates and vanishes for real z

checks.name: ricci_tensor
checks.detail: the Ricci tensor R^a_a = sum_b R^{ab}_{ab} and the Ricci scalar of the corrected metric equal the sympy record (ricci_mixed_diagonal_mathematica, ricci_scalar_mathematica); both are independent of x0

checks.name: history_source_equals_sympy
checks.detail: on the history a4 = H x4, b4 = E^(4 H x4/3): E_(1)^mu_mu and the author-weight sum E_(1)/H^2 + E_(2)/(32 H^4) + E_(3)/(1152 H^6) equal the sympy values (history_source) for -rho, p3, p_t, p0

checks.name: divergence_of_diagonal_tensor
checks.detail: corrected metric, T = diag(p0, p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t) depending on x0, x4: nabla_mu T^mu_x4 = -d4 rho - 3 a4' (rho + p3) - 3 h (rho + p_t) - h (rho + p0), h = b4'/(2 b4) - a4'; nabla_mu T^mu_x0 = d0 p0 + 3 H Cot[z] (p0 - p_t); the six other components vanish (every real z)

checks.name: dirac_gravity_term
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = sum_a gamma^(a) (1/(2 V)) d_a (V/f_a), V = f0 ... f7: (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) for every real z (= the sympy record: (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4))

checks.name: alternatives
checks.detail: alternative K (g00 = E^(2 a4) Cot[z]^2, 3-space E^(2 a4) S, extra times without the warp S): no mixed Riemann component and no off-diagonal component at any order; g00 = b4^(1/2) Cot[z]^2 (both warps): E_(1) diagonal, but E_(2)^x4_x0 = -(3/2) H Cot[z] b4' (4 a4' b4 - b4')^2/b4^3 != 0
